why: Wanda's discount brings it to {R}{R} once her power plus the reducers reach 7, and Livaan gives +9 when it's cast.
Wanda and Livaan count 5 creature types, so it casts five free copies of one graveyard spell. Five Seething Songs make 25 red, and five Fiery Confluences deal 30 to each opponent.
The closers role has 4 cards against 2 to 3, and Solphim ranks last in it (ledger dmg-019).
flags: Solphim adds two creature types (Phyrexian Horror), so cutting it means 5 copies instead of 7 on turns Solphim would be out.
Before the chain starts it's a dead {5}{R}{R} card.

options.note: Runner-up cut. The engines role is over target too, but you asked for Neheb on 2026-09-16.

why: Tapped on Livaan, each chain link roughly triples Wanda instead of doubling her. On Wiccan she gives two cards per noncreature spell.
Solphim doubles damage that's usually lethal already. Lwaxana raises the chain's real limits, Wanda's power and red pips.
flags: You brought Solphim into this list on 2026-09-08.
Her ability needs {T}, so she can't use it the turn she comes down.
In the barest modelled case Solphim kills (42 to each opponent) and Lwaxana doesn't (36).
